title: External pack contract — views
intro: How a skill pack outside Grove's repository joins the methodology, with ResearchSkills as the first pack, and where the disputed assets of the remaining moves go. Graphs begin at Start here; numbered edges give the order of the steps.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: One plugin layout for every pack: the plugin directory is the Ravel source directory and the Claude Code plugin root.

groups.title: References between skills
groups.description: Directed loads by bare name, inside one pack and across packs, and the outcome of a missing loaded skill.

groups.title: Conformance
groups.description: Each repository checks its own working tree against a pinned revision of the other, with Grove's runner and no copy.

groups.title: Distribution
groups.description: The native marketplace, the Ravel directory route and the manual installer, each from the published pack.

groups.title: Pack membership
groups.description: The membership decisions of pack-membership-k171: the format files, the always-on hooks, the asset rule and the proof that each move owes.

discussion.title: Homebrew installs the packs
discussion.status: Proposed by homebrew-delivery-design-k216 on 2026-11-06. It applies the human's decisions of skill-marketplace-decision-k201
discussion.summary: Grove's record plugins/packs.json names each pack's commit, check:packs reads it, and Grove's release copies each source directory into the keg. No marketplace lists a pack, and no installer links a skill.

updatedDiagrams.summary: Replaced the three routes with one: Grove's record, check:packs, the release archive, the keg and the Ravel source record.
The release copies the source directory into the keg, and Ravel reads the copy. The manifest stays as metadata, and the plugin cache and the installer links go.
Grove's check reads plugins/packs.json in place of the marketplace.
The pruned marketplace step became homebrew-skill-delivery-k215, which proves the keg contents and the hook registration.
Grove's keg, not WritingSkills, holds the Codex marketplace file writing-hooks.

diagrams.title: One source directory, copied into the keg
diagrams.caption: Grove's release copies plugins/research alone into its keg, so the digest covers only delivered files. Ravel reads the keg copy. The manifest stays as metadata that no route installs. The repository root holds what the pack does not deliver.

diagrams.title: Directed loads of the research kinds
diagrams.caption: Amber nodes ship in ResearchSkills and blue nodes ship in core. Each research kind loads the spine across packs. The pair also loads its family skill inside the pack. A loaded skill that is absent sends the session to the launch prompt's rule.

diagrams.title: Two checks, each against a pinned revision
diagrams.caption: Grove checks its working tree against the pack commit that its record plugins/packs.json names. The pack checks its working tree against a recorded Grove commit from Grove's public remote, and runs that commit's runner.

diagrams.title: From a published commit to a session
diagrams.caption: Proposed by homebrew-delivery-design-k216. The release copies each pack from the checkout that check:packs used, so the keg holds the commit that the check accepted. Homebrew links the keg source into Ravel's default skill directory, which Ravel 2.0.0 reads with no settings. No marketplace lists a pack, and no installer links its skills.

diagrams.title: The format files stay in the spine
diagrams.caption: Blue nodes stay in core and amber nodes ship in DesignSkills. Every kind reaches the two format files through the spine. The craft skills deepen the formats, and the formats bind without them.

diagrams.title: WritingSkills owns the always-on hooks
diagrams.caption: Each hooks plugin runs the scripts and sends the texts of the skill beside it, so no path crosses repositories. The owner's settings enable the Claude Code hooks plugin. A native user installs the ordinary writing plugin, and its dependency installs the same hooks plugin, so each hook has one declaration. Grove's keg holds the Codex marketplace file, which is not a part of the layer. guardrail stays a native-only plugin in PersonalSkills.

diagrams.title: The asset rule, in order
diagrams.caption: The first test that matches decides. Each move classifies every Grove file that names its skills and records the result.

diagrams.title: The boundary that each move proves first
diagrams.caption: Amber moves owe the proofs of a boundary beside the base proofs. Grey moves owe the base proofs and their own checks. The staging trials later run every source on both harnesses.
